description: OpenAI-compatible serverless inference for a curated catalogue of open models.
residency_notes: Wafer says inference is served from data centers in the United States. Standard Serverless requests may retain anonymized prompt/completion logs for up to 30 days; ZDR-enabled or ZDR-required Serverless requests do not write prompts or completions to durable storage, but operational metadata may remain.
prompt_training_notes: Wafer says prompts and completions are not used to train the served models; its policy separately describes limited use for internal draft-model performance work outside Zero Data Retention traffic.

sources.notes: Official model cards document the bearer-authenticated /v1/chat/completions endpoint and current serverless model slugs.

verification.notes: Verified against Wafer's first-party model quick starts and model catalogue.
